ALCHEMIST-FERMENT.description: This card increases in power for each turn in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Playing it transforms it into a [gold]Toxic[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-FERMENT.title: Ferment
ALCHEMIST-INFUSE.description: [gold]Enchant[/gold] a card until the end of combat. Attacks become [purple]Laced[/purple]; Skills become [purple]Dosed[/purple]; Powers become [purple]Potent[/purple]. Other cards gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-INFUSE.title: Infuse
